# bind-keyboard

> Lightweight (~4.5KB gzip), dependency-free TypeScript library for binding keyboard shortcuts in the browser — layout-agnostic matching via `event.code`, a cross-platform `cmdOrCtrl` modifier, and input-safe by default.

bind-keyboard binds callback functions to keyboard key combinations (e.g. `"cmdOrCtrl+k"`, `"shift+d"`, a bare `"Escape"`). It has zero runtime dependencies, works with plain JS/TS or any framework by creating a `BindKeyboard` instance on mount and calling `.destroy()` on unmount, and is safe to import during server-side rendering — it skips autostart instead of throwing when there's no DOM yet.

## Docs

- [Full reference](https://vladislav-pavlikov.github.io/bind-keyboard/llms-full.txt): the entire README inlined into one file — constructor options, the full `.add()`/`.remove()`/`.getKeybind()`/`.getAllBindings()` API, error types — no links to follow.
- [README](https://github.com/vladislav-pavlikov/bind-keyboard/blob/main/README.md): same content, rendered on GitHub.
- [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/vladislav-pavlikov/bind-keyboard/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): version history.
- [Live demo](https://vladislav-pavlikov.github.io/bind-keyboard/): an on-screen keyboard highlighting detected combinations, a live shortcuts panel, and copy-pasteable code samples for Vanilla/React/Vue/Svelte in TS or JS.

## Quick start

```ts
import BindKeyboard from "bind-keyboard";

const bindKeyboard = new BindKeyboard();

bindKeyboard.add("cmdOrCtrl+k", (event) => {
  event.preventDefault();
  // your code here
});
```
